name: subscription-graveyard
description: Subscription Graveyard: bury the subscriptions you canceled and watch the savings add up. Cloudflare Worker + D1.
author: Jen Soltys

scripts.db:setup:local: wrangler d1 execute subscription-graveyard --local --file schema.sql && wrangler d1 migrations apply subscription-graveyard --local
scripts.db:setup:remote: wrangler d1 execute subscription-graveyard --remote --file schema.sql && wrangler d1 migrations apply subscription-graveyard --remote
